name: graffiti
description: TAG the front of a building with a can of spray paint. The `graffiti` crime has been in the registry at 0.3 stars since the crime system was built, charging nobody because there was no verb — this is the verb. Three rules shape it: you spray a BUILDING on an adjacent exit (flags.is_building), never open ground, so a tag always lands on a thing that exists and says which thing; there is exactly ONE tag per street tile and anyone may paint over anyone, which makes the wall a contested slot rather than a noticeboard (and makes the cap a PRIMARY KEY rather than a rule somebody enforces); and a tag ages out after 3 game days, derived from the game DATE rather than a tick, so it's stateless and a restart can't repaint the city. RAM is authoritative — every tag hydrates once and the room-description path never queries. Player text is escaped on the way IN and stored escaped, since it lands in a stranger's HTML. `spraycan` opens the can properly (the verb is not `spray`: the flight plugin already owns that one for the Locust crop-duster boom, and plugins do not beat each other): an in-browser dialog with per-letter colour off the shared paint-shop wheel, bold/italic/underline/strike, and a shelf of saved designs to load. It weakens none of the above, because STYLE IS DATA AND NEVER MARKUP — colour and weight travel as validated runs ([{n,c,f}]) alongside text that is still escaped exactly as before, so there is no markup in a room description to parse and none to get wrong. Removal is the cleaning plugin's `clean`, which needs a real tool for paint: bare hands do floor filth, not brickwork.

sprayapply.note: Client transport only — the spray-can dialog's SPRAY IT, carrying a base64 {text, runs} payload. Sent silently so a blob never lands in the log. Everything in it is re-validated server-side; the dialog decides nothing.

spraysave.note: Client transport only — the dialog's SAVE. Answers with the whole fresh shelf (type: spray_shelf) rather than a delta, so the panel can never drift from the table.

spraydel.note: Client transport only — the dialog's bin. Scoped by player_id in the DELETE, so it can only ever remove somebody's own.
